_comment: Scraper slugs the daily audit should NOT flag as broken when they emit zero events. Two kinds: aggregators that emit child slugs under different names, and venues that are legitimately empty between seasons (verified by hand). Add a slug here only after confirming the source genuinely has no upcoming events.
bad-vilbel-open-air-kino: seasonal — summer open-air cinema in the Freibad; the oak-26 season ran 22 Jul – 9 Aug 2026 and is over. Parser verified against the live Gatsby page-data: all 15 oak-26 films and their dates still parse, they are simply all past.
bnai-brith-frankfurt: network-unreachable — site returns HTTP 503 service unavailable
cafe-mutz: seasonal — FilmClub in Sommerpause after July 1, 2026 (last screening); August/September programme not yet published on cafemutz.de as of early July 2026. Parser verified: category-4 WP REST API returns no future posts.
deichtorhallen: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: deichtorhallen-phoxxi, deichtorhallen-halle-aktuelle-kunst, deichtorhallen-sammlung-falckenberg
deutsche-akademie-darmstadt: between programme blocks — the events archive (/en/activities/events, and the German /de/aktivitaeten/veranstaltungen) lists nothing after 13 Jul 2026; the Akademie's autumn block (Herbsttagung) is not yet published. Parser verified: it extracts all 13 of the 2026 list rows.
deutsches-apotheken-museum: sporadic — the Heidelberg museum lists public events one at a time; /fuehrungen/oeffentliche-veranstaltungen currently carries a single teaser (Workshop Duftmedizin, 08.08.2026) which is now past. Parser verified against the live listing + detail markup ('Datum: Samstag, 08. August 2026' parses to 2026-08-08).
deutsches-schauspielhaus: seasonal — Sommerpause July 3 to August 17, 2026; new season (FREMDE SONNE etc.) starts 26 September 2026; Reservix subdomain deutsches-schauspielhaus-hamburg.reservix.de is verified but publishes no events between seasons.
dig-frankfurt: seasonal — summer pause; last listed event was 30 Jun 2026 ('Der lange Arm der Mullahs'); no upcoming events on frankfurt.deutsch-israelische-gesellschaft.de/termine/ as of July 2026. Tribe Events API returns empty.
fes-hessen: seasonal — Landesbüro Hessen only occasionally hosts events in Frankfurt; current listing (Jun 2026) has events in Hanau, Steinbach, Wiesbaden etc. but none in Frankfurt
forschungskolleg-humanwissenschaften: seasonal — FKH archive/events currently shows no upcoming dates after 2 Jul 2026; next programme block not yet published on-site.
freiluftkino-frankfurt: seasonal — open-air cinema, no programme outside the summer season (verified live: 0 events)
hamburger-puppentheater: seasonal — in Sommerpause (summer break); new season starts September 2026; website confirms next programme announced late summer
hamburger-studienbibliothek: sporadic — small critical-theory library (studienbibliothek.org); avant-garde 'Bibliothekskonzerte' + occasional talks published only as prose in the index news feed, extracted via the AI proxy into html-events-cache.ts (refresh-html-cache.ts). Latest listed event was 22 Jun 2026; often empty between events.
hamburgmusik: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: elbphilharmonie, laeiszhalle
hansa-theater: seasonal — Varieté season runs October to May; dark/empty during summer
harburger-theater: verified live: source lists no upcoming events
imd-darmstadt: biennial — Darmstädter Ferienkurse run in odd years (last 2025, next 10–24 Jul 2027); the festival/programm pages still show the 2025 edition and carry no ztix booking links, so there are no upcoming ticketed events between editions. The shared ztix parser is verified against the other Darmstadt venues.
jazz-palmengarten: seasonal — Palmengarten summer jazz series, silent off-season (verified live: 0 events)
jazzkeller: between programme months — live.html (Brizy CMS) shows May+June 2026, last dated show 27 Jun; July not yet published as of 29 Jun 2026. Parser verified: extracts all 15 June rows (dates/times/ticket links) when run against an earlier today.
karl-marx-buchhandlung: seasonal — bookshop often has no events booked beyond the next few weeks
lichtmess-kino: seasonal — small volunteer arthouse between programmes; /programm lists nothing after 12 Jun 2026 (parser verified working on the past rows).
lichtwark-theater: seasonal — theater between seasons/summer pause (May 5 to mid-August)
mathildenhoehe: between exhibitions — both /ausstellungen/aktuell/ and /ausstellungen/vorschau/ render the empty marker ('Es sind derzeit keine Ausstellungen in dieser Kategorie eingetragen') as of 24 Jun 2026; the site lists no current or upcoming exhibitions. Parser verified — it keys off that marker and the <article> list.
museums-frankfurt: aggregator — fans out to the per-museum slugs
museums-hamburg: aggregator — fans out to child slugs: altonaer-museum, jenisch-haus, speicherstadtmuseum, museum-der-arbeit, deutsches-hafenmuseum, museum-fuer-hamburgische-geschichte
nippon-connection: seasonal — annual late-May/early-June film festival; empty between editions (2026 edition ran 2–7 Jun)
openbooks-frankfurt: seasonal — annual October festival; empty the rest of the year
orfeos-erben: verified live: source lists no upcoming events
roemerberggespraeche: seasonal — lecture series runs ~twice a year; empty between editions
schauspiel-frankfurt: seasonal — Sommerpause July–August 2026; new season starts 11 September 2026 with premieres of Schwejk, Antigone, Arturo Ui etc. Scrapers selectors verified against live markup.
taunale-oberursel: annual — TAUNALE Taunus Filmfest ran 5–9 Aug 2026 (gcal CTA 'dates=20260805/20260810'); the scraper deliberately emits nothing once an edition has ended, until the next edition's dates are published.
theater-fuer-kinder: seasonal — TLS cert invalid on own site, Reservix subdomain returns generic page; venue between seasons as of June 2026
tu-darmstadt-vortraege: semester-break gap — lecture series resumes with the new term (verified live: 0 events)
uni-heidelberg-ringvorlesung: between semesters — the Ruperto Carola series ran Sommersemester 2026 (11 May – 20 Jul); the Wintersemester 2026/27 programme is not yet on the landing page. Parser verified: it still extracts all 8 SoSe date blocks with titles from the live page.
wdc2026: aggregator — fans out to wdc2026-* child slugs
ypsilon-buchladen: seasonal — bookshop reading programme between seasons; last events were May 2026, next programme expected late summer 2026
